title: OneDrive synced folder
whyItMatters: The synced folder mirrors work and private files to the cloud, and may hold Desktop, Documents and Pictures too. Signing out of OneDrive does not remove the local copies.
source: Microsoft Learn, OneDrive Known Folder Move and default sync folder under the user profile: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/onedrive/redirect-known-folders
notes: Personal accounts use OneDrive; work or school accounts use OneDrive - <Organization> next to it; the OneDrive* glob matches both (one trace per folder). With Known Folder Move, Desktop, Documents and Pictures live inside this folder. File placeholders may be cloud-only.

cleanup.exportFirst: Copy the files you want to keep out of the OneDrive folder to a drive you are taking with you.
cleanup.signOut: In OneDrive, open Help and Settings > Settings > Account and choose Unlink this PC, so the account stops syncing here.
steps: Confirm the files you need are copied somewhere safe.
Close OneDrive from the notification area.
Unlink the account in OneDrive settings.
Delete the OneDrive folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Local copies of synced files are removed; cloud-only placeholders disappear first and files not copied leave this PC.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Support, Turn off, disable, or uninstall OneDrive: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/onedrive/turn-off-disable-or-uninstall-onedrive
